run_HTTPServer: run a Python HTTP server on localhost with a configurable port defaulting to 10080
run_HTTPServer_with_ssl: run a Python HTTP server with SSL enabled using PEM certificate and key files
test_Handler_do_GET: test the Handler class do_GET method that responds to /get path with a 200 HTML response
test_Handler_do_POST: test the Handler class do_POST method that responds to /post path with content 'hello'
review_Handler_good: review the Handler class good method that sends a 200 response with HTML content
